blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Health authorities in Rosario town, Agusan del Sur, recorded 858 dengue cases and five deaths since January, prompting renewed calls for residents to intensify mosquito-control measures. As of Friday, data from the Municipal Health Office (MHO) showed that 37 dengue cases remain active. Barangay Sta. Cruz recorded the highest number of cumulative infections with 171 cases, followed closely by Bayugan 3 with 169, Cabantao with 100, Poblacion with 97, Novele with 80, Tagbayagan with 79, Libuac with 67, Cabawan with 43, Wasian with 33, Maligaya with 13, and Marfil with six.
